body:
MDMA That Was Not, Suspected MBDB
I've been trying to fight the urge to write this report as I'm currently on my  4th day awake no sleep (still feel good tho)
Background:
--canadian male with extensive drug abuse background that started when I was in high school (16 years ago.)
--daily weed, coke/crack, meth/all stims, opiates, benzos...the list goes on
--was originally a psychonaught and trip sitter/guide in highscchool
was originally a psychonaught and trip sitter/guide in highscchool
and was using chems for the value and insight for my young mind.
--due to depression/anxiety following the death of a close relative 4 years ago I began abusing powder cocaine (room mate sold)
--so in 2015-2018 I had 3 years heavy addiction to coke, then I tried crack and it got so bad I spent almost all of 2019 in rehab programs, sober homes, etc.
I was most recently sober for 2 months (nov/dec 2019) and caved to my cravings and went looking for uppers, couldnt connect to anyone to help me (I lost contact with dealers to stay clean). After figuring out tor, I ordered online from a vendor that I've no experience with because I've never done this before...I even got scammed 300$ worth of btc for the first vendor I tried. So, the below happened mostly in january 2020 except for the main body of my report below.
--first package arrived 7 days later and it was as ordered: 1xmdma, 1xketamine and  10pillsx220mgxMCAT (4-MMC)
-- I got my second package, this one with 5 hits of 220mcg LSD
-- bitter blotter, suspect nbome immediately but I didnt spitter the bitter
--lucky the blotter was weak cuz I ate 2 more a few hours later, this time I was already stimulated from the other subs. Grew to a respectable trip similar to an 8th of shrooms. Not a bad day, emailed asking the vendors to tell me what chem I was on (suspected 2ci-nbome) but they didnt respond to that question.
--it was my 3rd package which I got yesterday when I realised it wasnt as ordered; I ordered the 'mdma' and they even doubled it for me for free! Awesome doubled my order! Probably cuz of my complaint about the cid?
--the substance didnt taste right. No liquorice/rootbeer/sass it was more like light-cathinone-flavour + bitter chem
--granular fine/beige substance, not 'clumpy'
Experience:
Awake for 2 nights on lisdexamp before my recent package come yesterday
Awake for 2 nights on lisdexamp before my recent package come yesterday
, I could wait to get started...addiction is rough....but I started this 'molly' with a big parachute (150mg wrapped in zig zag) and snorted about 50mg.
I cant detail all my dosing since yesterday but it was frequent repeats of the above until I lost 3 or 4 hours at a time doing stuff like this trip report. 1 probably have 0.5g left right now out of 2g
I've no doubt its a phenylethylamine. Here are the effects I can recollect at this point in time:
-intense lethargy at times
-effects come up suddenly/abruptly, this stuff is rushy like crack for a few minutes when a parachute opens or when I do another line.
-only mild euphoria for an hour and then none for the rest of my trip.
-not terribly 'speedy' or tweaking, more relaxed, muscles arent clenching
-no eye shakes for me (which I get on coke really bad)
-no real appetite but I can and have eat(en)
-issues with thermoregulation.
-no mental clarity, more intoxicated feeling,
-confusion at times
-memory issues
-no visuals, except for the drug induced psychosis I've been in for more than a day now.
